_comment: CARD: carry-aware covariance readback (docs/SPEC_carry_aware_covariance.md) - arm P1.
ONE variable vs _ft63_cacov_off.json: network.carry_aware_covariance.
THE GATE IS UNUSUAL AND IT IS THE STRONGEST ONE THIS PROJECT CAN STATE.  Both consumers
of the corrected covariance are READ-ONLY - dd_sigma_cyc is a trace column and the
producer AR is log-only ('Phase 2 is READ-ONLY (no re-pin / re-solve yet)').  So the
requirement is not 'OFF is byte-identical to the pre-edit exe'; it is that ARMED and
DISARMED produce BYTE-IDENTICAL SOLVE ARTIFACTS - identical products.txt md5, identical
snapshot but for its ISO write timestamp, unchanged fingerprint - and differ in exactly
two trace files.  Any solve-artifact difference is a WIRING BUG, not a result.
WHAT THE ARM IS FOR.  med|frac| ~ 0.25 is the EXPECTED reading whenever sigma_DD >~ 0.3
cyc, so RUNQUEUE_pdfix_reask's P6(b) null - 'the DD integer information is not present
at this cadence/geometry', the strongest negative in the campaign - cannot be tested
against a carry-blind sigma, and the only sigma the producer emitted was carry-blind
(pinned near 3.9 cyc; grade_pdfix_arms.py excludes it ON PURPOSE).  This arm produces
the sigma that can carry that test.
GRADE, in order:
1. THE gate above (md5 identity vs cacov_off).
2. Run-end 'carry-aware covariance' line: ratio min/mean/max, and nonpos_rows.  A
ratio identically 1.00 means the correction reached nothing - dead wiring, not a
quiet run (invariant #4).  A NON-ZERO nonpos_rows is a result about the FOLD (the
per-block Woodbury composition is inexact wherever a station sits in two blocks)
and opens its own card - it is not a defect of this readback.
3. dd_sigma_cyc by chord age, ON vs OFF: the mature bins must fall by orders; the
freshly-born bins must NOT move (a diffuse prior carries no information).
4. THE PAYOFF: med|frac| CONDITIONED on dd_sigma_cyc bins
(scripts/grade_ddfrac_sigma_conditioned.py).  On the sigma < 0.25 cyc population,
is the fractional part still uniform?
